notes.title: GAME RELEASED
notes.notes:
Hide n' Seek has been released!

🚀 Unleash your inner explosive genius in "Hide and Explode"! 🎉 Gather your friends for a brainless multiplayer adventure where seekers turn the battlefield into fireworks using hiders' body parts. Can you survive and blend in with hilariously obvious decoys? Discover power-ups to outwit your opponents. Prepare for mind-numbing absurdity and laughter-filled failures. Get ready for the countdown to launch! 💣🔥 #HideAndExplode
